unsupported_container_handling.RAR_or_7Z_received: Do not invoke external executable unpackers automatically. Preserve top-level SHA-256/bytes and hold until a separately frozen safe transport method is admitted or the sender supplies ZIP/TAR/raw originals.
unsupported_container_handling.encrypted_archive_received: Preserve bytes and HOLD; do not request or brute-force passwords as part of scientific intake unless provenance holder supplies legitimate access information and a new receipt records it.
unsupported_container_handling.installer_or_EXE_received: Never execute for intake. Preserve/hash as raw bytes; if source-specific static inspection is later required, freeze a separate static-analysis gate first.
